decision_reason: The current hash-pinned PAH-OMC-014 contract fixes the intended full-Q domain, fixed-Q Gibbs components, cylinder observables, and ordered limits, while its intake verifier confirms that no source-owned cross-Q law is present. R495 supplies only conditional finite-mixture positivity/normalization and R496 supplies only a conditional Cauchy-to-limit bridge. The audit therefore separates the conditions already fixed from those that cannot be evaluated: projective consistency, PAH-specific Cauchy errors, R-488 nonzero, and full-Q stationarity remain uninstantiated. The active verdict stays HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE.
finding: Completion audit: (1) fixed-Q components, full-Q domain, cylinder and n/R_max order are pinned PASS; (2) no-fitting firewall PASS; (3) PAH-specific epsilon_(n,R)(f) and its limit MISSING; (4) R495 positivity/normalization is only conditional, R-488 nonzero MISSING; (5) full-Q omega(Lf)=0 MISSING; (6) R-484 16/9 is retained as an accounted boundary defect but no full-Q error estimate exists; (7) source-owned law absence is confirmed and requires HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE; (8) exact projective consistency and weak cylinder convergence are both NOT_TESTABLE, so no universal no-go is asserted. The three existing verifiers pass their scoped assertions without changing the parent model.
method: Read the current PAH-OMC-014 contract and source-owner intake contract and hash-pin their present bytes.
Map each of the eight objective conditions to the exact existing manifest or integrated verifier assertion.
Rerun the intake, R495 and R496 verifiers and confirm their scoped PASS outputs remain claim-nonbearing.

missing_assumptions: A source-owner hash-pinned nonnegative normalized cross-Q law or equivalent projective probability kernel.
A PAH-specific cylinder topology and explicit epsilon_(n,R)(f) Cauchy bound in the fixed order.
An R-488 nonzero estimate and a domain/uniform-integrability proof for omega(Lf)=0.
next_action: Obtain the one source-owner payload that instantiates the missing law, topology, Cauchy error, R-488 witness, and stationarity domain; then rerun the existing intake and R495/R496 verifiers without changing PAH-001.
non_claims: No full-Q Gibbs state or common positive normalized limit function omega is constructed.
No projective consistency, weak cylinder convergence, R-488 nonzero bound, or stationarity identity is proved.
No infinite-volume semigroup, quantum real-time, physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, or TOE conclusion follows.

question: Which of the eight PAH-OMC-014 completion conditions are genuinely established by the current contracts and conditional Lean bridges, and which remain untestable without a source-owned full-Q law?
title: PAH-OMC-014 eight-condition audit isolates the source-law and limit gaps
